name: Jamaica
about: Dry season (Dec–Apr) is the classic window; hurricane season runs Jun–Nov, peaking Aug–Oct.
overview: Reggae's birthplace and Blue Mountain coffee country, with more genuine local culture behind its music and nightlife than most Caribbean resort islands.
costOverview: Street-side jerk chicken is a real bargain — tourist-zone taxis and paid attractions like Dunn's River Falls cost noticeably more.

specialSeasons.text: Reggae Sumfest brings the island's biggest music festival to Montego Bay.
Peak hurricane season, with real storm risk and the fewest visitors of the year.
